name: sb3-train-demo
notes: The ADR-0028 declared RL doorway. This config VALIDATES as shipped (shape + hash) but running it needs the one thing that is rightly yours: the environment. Replace `env` with your gymnasium.Env subclass's import path (a dskit child's simulator wrapper) and `python -m dskit.pipeline run` it — the algorithm, policy and every constructor knob stay config. sb3-eval measures the pinned artifact over episodes; its `split` declares which split's environment the wired env_params build (the score-role rule search objectives are held to).

agent.notes: algo_params pass to the SAC constructor verbatim (the pyomo solver_options precedent) — the library's signature is the contract

score.notes: same env class, the VAL period's dates — an eval lawfully measures on a different environment than training; only the model identity must match the artifact

splits.notes: 2024-01-01 / 2024-07-01 / 2025-01-01 — the cuts DOCUMENT the periods the env_params above build; for env-based scoring the split binding is declared, not mechanical (episodes are the env's to generate)
